notes_for_editor: Thin. The only tower-specific source is the FFLA Texas list, which gives name, county, coordinates and gone status and nothing else. Not on NHLR or FFLOS. Two searches and a handful of page reads found no build date, design, staffing, fires or site description. The TSHA material describes the town, not the tower; the link between the tower and the community rests on the shared name, which no source states. Coordinates were not checked against a map. The editor may cut the community paragraph if it reads as padding.
